author: CJE (via Newtral)
title: Cuánto presupuesto se dedica a la vivienda: así es la brecha entre…
what_it_does: A CJE researcher states the selection point: the ECV measures the burden of households already housed; those who cannot pay do not form a household and do not appear.
overlap_with_s24: States our question 2 and the framing of question 3; no quantification.

author: DatosRTVE
title: Los jóvenes frente al muro del alquiler en España
data: ECV microdata 2013-2025; Idealista asking price x SERPAVI mean area (78.6 m2)
what_it_does: Rent / household income for emancipated young households; asking rent / personal income for those at home; warns that effort indicators describe only those already independent. Notes that «solo compartiendo gastos con la pareja o compañeros se puede costear un alquiler».
overlap_with_s24: Closest prior work: same data, asking vs paid rent, household vs personal income, selection caveat. Not a decomposition of the CJE figure; no selection bound.

author: elDiario.es (A. Díez, Y. Jara, R. Sánchez)
title: Quiénes son los casi tres millones de personas que viven ahogadas por el alquiler en España
what_it_does: Share of tenants paying >30% of income in rent fell from 36.4% to 26.2% in ten years; attributes it mainly to income growth at the bottom (minimum wage, unemployment, labour reform, IMV) and also to «ahogados invisibles» who stay with or return to parents.
overlap_with_s24: States both explanations; does not quantify the selection share.

author: FEDEA (Conde-Ruiz & Pinto)
title: El Coste de la Vivienda y la Pobreza Oculta en España: 2014-2025
what_it_does: Housing cost burden and overburden by tenure (market rent 26.8% in 2025), poverty after housing costs, young households. Attributes part of the improvement to composition: «Parte de esta mejora coincide con el fuerte crecimiento en número de hogares y personas de este régimen, que introduce mayor heterogeneidad interna».
overlap_with_s24: Burden from ECV microdata already done, and a composition explanation of the fall already offered; not a bound, panel or age test, not the CJE figure.

author: FEDEA (F. Pinto)
title: Esfuerzo residencial y desigualdad económica en España: evidencia 2019-2024
what_it_does: Housing effort by tenure, quintile and household type; young single-person households most exposed.

author: Banco de España (Khametshin, López Rodríguez, Pérez García)
title: El mercado del alquiler de vivienda residencial en España (Documento Ocasional 2432)
what_it_does: Tenure by age of reference person; rent effort by income in the EU context; links high effort to delayed emancipation.

author: Funcas (D. Romero-Jordán)
title: ¿Cuál es el esfuerzo por vivir de alquiler en España? / Radiografía del elevado sobreesfuerzo de los jóvenes para alquilar vivienda
what_it_does: Rent effort of young (<35) renter households on consumption expenditure (~35%).

author: Eurofound (Hyland et al.)
title: Foundational challenges: The housing struggles of Europe's youth
what_it_does: Housing crisis impedes household formation; many young adults live with parents when they would prefer not to.

author: Echaves-García & Martínez del Olmo
title: Emancipación residencial y acceso de los jóvenes al alquiler en España (CyTET)
what_it_does: Falling emancipation and rising rental effort; regional patterns.

author: Colom Andrés & Molés Machí
title: Changes in Living Arrangements of Young Spanish Adults Over Time (Comparative Population Studies)
what_it_does: Decomposition of changes in living arrangements by education and labour status.

author: El Mundo
title: La paradoja de la vivienda en España: menos presión que en Europa…
what_it_does: Discusses the falling overburden as a paradox; cites FEDEA.
overlap_with_s24: Title only cited: the site reserves text and data mining (art. 67.3 RDL 24/2021); local copy deleted.
